2.260.14
MapLegend.MapSize
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The MapLegend.MapSize element specifies the size of a MapLegend. This element is optional. If this
element is not present, the size of the map legend MUST be automatically calculated. This element is
of type MapSize.
Following is the parent element of the MapLegend.MapSize element.
Parent elements
MapLegend
The following is the XML Schema definition of the MapLegend.MapSize element.
 <xsd:element name="MapSize" type="MapSizeType" minOccurs="0" />
